tools.note: Local JWT workflow, not an App Store Connect REST operation. It creates or reuses a cached ES256 token with a 20-minute lifetime and does not expose the token. Team Keys are signed with an iss claim; Individual API Keys are signed with sub=user. Long-lived scoped tokens are not supported.

Local in-memory cache inspection only. Validity means the cached token's decoded exp claim is beyond the configured refresh leeway; it is not server-side Apple validation.

tools.note: Performs local cryptographic validation for the configured non-scoped key contract using the private key's public key. It checks alg=ES256, typ=JWT, kid, aud=appstoreconnect-v1, iat ordering, exp-iat at most 1200 seconds, and exp beyond the refresh leeway. Team Keys must carry the configured iss; Individual API Keys must carry sub=user and no iss. It intentionally rejects long-lived scoped JWTs, does not call Apple, does not evaluate endpoint role permissions, and does not prove server acceptance.
